localChanges: Hydro and Nuclear Plants no longer need a Factory, and a Mfg. Plant needs only Robotics. Once a city has a Mfg. Plant it isn't offered a Factory, and a city that already gets Hoover Dam's bonus isn't offered a plant (closes #292).

A Library and a University each add half of a city's science before any other bonus, rather than building on each other, and Isaac Newton's College adds a third more for each. Copernicus' Observatory then doubles the total. A Factory adds 50% to a city's shields and a Mfg. Plant 100%, and a Power, Hydro or Nuclear Plant (or Hoover Dam) adds another 50%, but only in a city with a Factory or Mfg. Plant (closes #390).
